text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: There she is! Quick, get the cameras!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's like a riot in here. Way different vibes from other races I've been in.
choice_data_list: That's because it's the Hanshin J.F.
That's because it's the Hanshin J.F.

text_block_list.text: This is one of the few G1 races for junior-year runners. Those who achieve good results here are expected to do well in the years to come.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: All eyes on today's field, huh. Then this is my chance.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll show them a performance that will make them see me differently.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: For myself… and for everyone hoping for my success.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And, like, if you're supposed to be my trainer, don't you have anything better to say?
choice_data_list: Go out there and show them what you're made of!
Go out there and show them what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You don't have to tell me that!
